relevance.rationale: This is the paper an entire corpus audit is built on and it has no ref() entry. docs/audits/2026-07-25-quillen-anomaly-classification.md opens by naming this upload by filename, calls its Sect. 4 dichotomy 'the organizing principle', quotes its eqs. (4.1)-(4.2) 'verbatim' including the authors' own symbol for the non-holomorphic counterterm, and uses Sect. 2 and Sect. 5 to place the corpus's genus-1 identity det'Delta(E_tau) = (Im tau)^2 |eta(tau)|^4 in the anomaly-carrying class. A second audit, docs/audits/2026-07-25-alpha-em-r2-quillen-curvature-attack.md, cites its eqs. (4.18), (4.25)-(4.32) and (4.31) for the obstruction-weight family and the Weil-Petersson normalisation. Load-bearing in two audits and a probe, with zero bibliographic record: the metadata exists nowhere but an inline prose line in an audit doc.

keyResults.statement: Quillen's theorem in the form det_zeta = |det D|^2 e^{-q}: the zeta-regularised determinant of a chiral Dirac operator fails to be the modulus-squared of a holomorphic function by an explicit non-holomorphic counterterm.
keyResults.useForFolio: The cited theorem behind the audit's class-(b) assignment: it is what turns 'det'Delta has nonzero partial-partialbar curvature' into 'det'Delta is not |f|^2 for any holomorphic f', which is the corpus's exact-gates-vs-stuck-magnitudes split.

keyResults.statement: For the family D: L^n -> L^{n+2} the holomorphic-anomaly obstruction carries weight 3(n+1)^2 - 1, with an explicit Weil-Petersson normalisation, and the resulting objects make no reference to a distinguished constant.
keyResults.useForFolio: The spin-content candidate family used by the alpha_EM r^2 Quillen-curvature attack; it is the source of the weight formula that audit enumerates candidates against.

keyResults.statement: The genus-1 special case, in which the spin-structure-dependent determinant is expressed through theta and eta functions.
keyResults.useForFolio: Sources the corpus's genus-1 identity det'Delta(E_tau) = (Im tau)^2 |eta(tau)|^4, which the audit computes the exact Quillen curvature of.

keyResults.statement: The spin-structure dependence of the chiral Dirac determinant on a Riemann surface is given by Riemann's theta function.
keyResults.useForFolio: The audit uses this to identify the interior theta factor as the anomaly-carrying norm sector; it is also the natural literature anchor for the corpus's otherwise unsourced one-sentence rem:sign-as-spin-structure, though that remark's object (a ribbon twist sign on sqrt(q)) is not the same object and should not be conflated with a determinant line bundle.

proposedActions.rationale: Quoted by section and equation number in two audit docs and used as the organizing principle of a live research axis, with no ref() entry; its bibliographic data currently lives only in a blockquote in one audit doc.

The exact-rational-gates vs anomaly-carrying-magnitudes dichotomy is described in the audit as the organizing principle for the alpha_EM magnitude leg, yet it exists nowhere in content/. Promoting it to a remark (explicitly audit-tier, nothing wired) would make the classification citable from the folio rather than only from docs/audits/.
